# E-Bix Software Solutions

E-Bix Software Solutions is a premium custom software development, mobile application, and web design agency based in Sri Lanka, serving clients globally. We specialize in building high-performance, scalable digital platforms, custom software, and digital marketing systems that drive business growth.

## Core Information
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.ebixtechsolutions.site/
- **Location:** Colombo, Sri Lanka
- **Contact Phone:** +94 75 074 7029
- **Contact Email:** hello@e-bix.com
- **Co-Founders:** Sahan Dhanujaya, Sherul Dhanuska, Mahesh Hansaka

## Services Offered
1. **Custom Web Design:** High-converting, lightning-fast, mobile-friendly websites built with modern frameworks (React, Vite, Framer Motion).
2. **AI Video Marketing:** Advanced generative AI solutions to create cinematic, highly engaging promotional videos for brands.
3. **Hospitality & OTA Setup:** Automated synchronization of Booking.com, Airbnb, and Google Maps to maximize direct bookings and occupancy rates for villas and hotels.
4. **SEO & Digital Growth:** Local SEO optimization, Google Business Profile scaling, and high-intent keyword positioning.
